items.title: Announcing OpenAI’s Bug Bounty Program
items.summary: This initiative is essential to our commitment to develop safe and advanced AI. As we create technology and services that are secure, reliable, and trustworthy, we need your help.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI正式宣布推出漏洞赏金计划，邀请全球安全研究人员协助发现并修复其AI服务中的安全漏洞。此举旨在提升其生成式AI技术与平台服务的安全性、可靠性与信任度。
